text:
maria: Heads-up — I dug into a customer report: tokens are being charged after a streaming request got truncated, client reconnects and we end up charging again when a toolcall replayed. Feels like provisional credits at handoff aren't being deduped on resume.
kevin: ugh. any repro steps / sample session id?
maria: yes — router logs show this pattern: handoff to region-b, provisional ledger entry, client reconnects to region-c and we create another provisional then confirm both later. snippet from router logs: 
```
2026-03-18T16:12:01Z router-1 HANDOFF session=svc-7Yk last_ack=125 provisional_id=pv-9a
2026-03-18T16:12:02Z downstream-b ACCEPT session=svc-7Yk start_offset=126 toolcall=calc-42
2026-03-18T16:12:10Z client reconnect session=svc-7Yk new_route=region-c resume_from=125
2026-03-18T16:12:11Z router-2 PROVISIONAL_CREATE session=svc-7Yk provisional_id=pv-9b
2026-03-18T16:12:18Z downstream-c ACCEPT session=svc-7Yk confirmed_ids=[pv-9a,pv-9b]
```
kevin: so we confirm both pv-9a & pv-9b — double charge. looks like we don't match on the original in-flight toolcall metadata.
sara: Does the router propagate the original toolcall nonce or trace id? If not we can't dedupe across routes.
maria: router hands off a `handoff_id` but it isn't included in provisional ledger entries today. provisional entries only have session + offset + provisional_id.
alex: quick mitigation: include `handoff_id` + `downstream_req_id` in the provisional metadata and use that in reconciliation to dedupe before confirming. downside: storage/size bump and some systems already have schema constraints.
sara: long term we should: 1) add session_origin_id (hand off id) to provisional credits, 2) update reconciler to group confirmed credits by session_origin_id before inflating charges, 3) surface provisional vs confirmed in console billing view. ops UX ask: show provisional credits as a separate row with hover explaining "may be reconciled on confirm".
kevin: agree. Also we need telemetry so SRE can alert on provisional spikes: metric provisional_credits_created{region,deploy,route} and a tag for resume_count.
maria: good call. also found edge where truncation + toolcall TTL causes provisional to be created but downstream never accepts before reconnect => orphaned provisional. we need better GC or tombstones.
alex: short term patch: when we detect a resume that carries `resume_from <= last_ack` and we find an earlier provisional with same session+offset, mark new provisional as deduped and don't create ledger entry. That should reduce noise.
sara: UI/console changes: - show provisional credits in Route -> Requests pane - add a toggle to include provisional in cost estimate - chart over time of provisional vs confirmed
kevin: who wants to own the reconciler change? @maria?
maria: I can own the reconciliation grouping + adding handoff_id to provisional entries. will draft an RFC.
kevin: i'll take the short-term router patch (dedupe on session+offset if found) — posting PR after standup.
sara: i'll do the console mockups and add the metric dashboards (panel + alert).
alex: i'll do a quick storage schema review for adding handoff_id.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/provisional-dedupe -> staging at 2026-03-19T02:00Z :rocket:
maria: thanks all. I'll make an RFC and link repro traces + sample consumer report in it. :thumbsup:
